facts.name: Wesley R. Douglas
facts.assignment: Profile: Columbia one-half circuit civil and domestic relations/DOR petitioner L–Z; Hamilton circuit civil/domestic relations/DOR; Lafayette felony cases. Family Law Administrative Judge.

contact.contact_note: Shared office/assistant number; no dedicated personal judge email.

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Profile publishes assistant email and office phone; shared notice prohibits ex parte communications.
procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Profile provides scheduling/general-inquiry form; no request submitted.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Circulate proposed orders by service/designated email; retain source five-business-day response procedure. No separate general motion-conferral instruction located.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: No judge-specific submission instructions established in reviewed sources.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Email .docx to JA after providing opposing party a copy. Identify hearing date in cover letter; competing drafts are forwarded after both received. Source treats no response within five business days as agreement, to be noted in cover letter. Counsel must deliver signed order to pro se parties electronically where designated, otherwise by mail.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: No judge-specific courtesy-copy instructions established in reviewed sources.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: No judge-specific remote instructions established in reviewed sources.

facts.review_scope: Official profile and one-page linked proposed-order instructions reviewed; general civil submission mechanics summarized, family-specific final-judgment details not abstracted. Targeted official search found older shared orders, no separate current hearing/manual instructions.
facts.summary: Civil judge; email Word proposed orders to JA after circulation to other parties. Profile provides scheduling/inquiry form.
